hypothesis: On held-out COCO-20i base-class 5-shot episodes, removing exactly one complete support-memory entry has meaningful safe-oracle headroom over matched all-support SANSA, justifying a later learned query-conditioned contribution selector.

baseline.causal_control: B0 generated on the same formal implementation SHA, checkpoint, episode manifest, cached feature context, and query decoder path

legacy_reference.reuse_policy: Audit only. Do not cherry-pick the single-support logit-fusion implementation, reuse its expected-IoU head, or inherit its tuned fallback margin.

episode_manifest.identity_policy: Every query and all five support identities are mutually disjoint across all three partitions.

stage_a_usage.train: unused and reserved for a later stage
stage_a_usage.calibration: unused and reserved for a later stage
stage_a_usage.validation: single locked Stage A operator-headroom evaluation

fixed_operator.name: drop_exactly_one_complete_support_memory_v1
fixed_operator.b0: All five support-memory entries are visible to the standard SANSA query decode.
fixed_operator.drop_variant: Dj removes the complete memory feature, positional encoding, and object pointer associated with frozen support slot j; the remaining four entries preserve their original order and values.

deterministic_similarity.support_descriptor: Masked average pooling of the final SANSA image-encoder feature map using the nearest-neighbor resized ground-truth support mask.
deterministic_similarity.query_descriptor: Global average pooling of the final SANSA image-encoder feature map without query masks or predictions.
deterministic_similarity.score: Cosine similarity between L2-normalized support and query descriptors.

derived_rows.selection: one uniformly selected support slot from SHA256(episode_id, random_seed), for frozen seeds 0 through 4
mean of the five frozen random-control effects
ground truth selects the highest episode-IoU D0-D4 result and must drop one support
ground truth selects max(B0,D0-D4) and drops a support only for strict positive episode gain

evaluation.paired_effect: episode foreground IoU treatment minus B0

decision_rules.pass_to_stage_b: B8_positive aggregate class-mIoU improvement is at least 0.5 point AND its paired 95% CI lower bound is greater than zero, with all provenance, replay, and guardrail checks passing.
decision_rules.deterministic_candidate: In addition to Stage A PASS, B2S improves aggregate class-mIoU by at least 0.5 point, has a paired 95% CI lower bound greater than zero, and passes both guardrails.
decision_rules.drop: With complete valid evidence, B8_positive aggregate class-mIoU improvement is below 0.5 point OR its paired 95% CI lower bound is not greater than zero.
decision_rules.revise: Changing the number of removed supports, using continuous weighting, changing the similarity descriptor, dataset, shots, primary metric, threshold, or stop rule requires a new Experiment ID.
decision_rules.inconclusive: The manifest, formal SHA, complete primitive rows, matched identities, artifacts, provenance, or valid software execution is missing.

compute.gpu_policy: one independent process on one GPU
compute.artifact_policy: outside Git, immutable, one directory per run
